frontmatter.title: A complete bounded factoring driver
frontmatter.description: Random bases, recycled-control phase estimation, failed trials, verified factors and explicit stopping limits.

children.value: A successful fixed-base order measurement is only one part of factoring. A driver must also recognize easy classical cases, choose bases, retain failed measurements, verify proposed factors and stop honestly when its budget is spent. This page implements that full control flow for bounded inputs, using the actual modular arithmetic from the

, an exact bounded prime classification, or an explicit failure/resource limit. A recursive wrapper continues splits until all factors are prime or some components remain unresolved. The circuits and traces below are executed ideal simulations; no generic factoring confidence theorem or adaptive fault-tolerant projection is supplied.

models a different, fixed full-register circuit. It cannot be reused as this driver’s physical estimate. The current shared QDK adapter rejects resets and intermediate/classically controlled measurements; omitting them would remove work required by the implementation. A complete adaptive estimate still needs initialization/reset error and timing models, measurement-conditioned schedules, classical feedback latency, approximation budgets and faults across all possible trials. Physical resources are therefore
, while the recorded logical ledger is executed and complete for each observed ideal path.

Thirty-two dedicated tests cover the full bounded primality domain, exact roots, actual adaptive versus full-register circuit distributions, cap transitions, failed work, random-base success and recursive product invariants. Independent review additionally checked 54 exact policy comparisons and canonical sampled-path likelihoods. A branch verifier retains all positive-probability paths without truncation; raw state norms are checked and their floating-point normalization is recorded. This is numerical verification, not a theorem. No Lean formalization has been built for this driver.

provides bounded live controls in a local/Binder kernel. The static page requires no maintained server. Sampling is capped at 18 quantum wires; circuit construction has its own conservative operation guard. Branch enumeration has an immutable six-output-bit cap and a separate maximum-amplitude allocation. Unsupported quantum components are reported explicitly, even when their classical preliminary checks were supported.
